name: marked-responsive-images
description: A robust marked extension for handling responsive images with srcset generation.

scripts.test: node --test && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); const lock = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package-lock.json', 'utf8')); if (pkg.version !== lock.version) { console.error('Version mismatch: package.json (' + pkg.version + ') vs package-lock.json (' + lock.version + ')'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run test && tsdown src/index.js --format cjs,esm,umd --global-name markedResponsiveImages --sourcemap --clean && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.copyFileSync('src/index.d.ts', 'dist/index.d.ts'))"

author: Eric Lowry
